title.zh: 转移分节恢复编码词序列
title.en: Transition grouping recovers encoded word sequences

statement.en: Grouping by adjacency returns a partition exactly where every group is nonempty, linked inside and not linked to the next, uniquely; it recovers the words of every encoded sequence exactly where each word is linked inside and no word's end links to any word's start.
statement.zh: 按相邻关系分组返回一个划分，恰当各组非空、内部相连且不连到下一组，该划分唯一；分组恢复每个编码序列的词，恰当每个词内部相连且没有词的末元素连到任何词的首元素。

laws.en: For any alphabet and any Boolean adjacency relation r, grouping reads a sequence from the right: an element joins the following group where r links it to that group's first element, and opens a new group otherwise; grouping never changes the sequence, the groups joined giving it back.
laws.zh: 对任一字母表与任一布尔相邻关系 r，分组由右向左读序列：元素在 r 把它连到其后一组的首元素时并入该组，否则另起一组；分组从不改变序列，各组连接起来就是原序列。

laws.en: Grouping by r returns a list of groups L of the sequence L joins exactly where every group of L is nonempty, linked by r at each adjacent pair inside, and not linked from its last element to the next group's first; a list so grouped that joins to a sequence is the only grouping of it.
laws.zh: 按 r 分组恰给出组列 L（就 L 连接成的序列而言），当且仅当 L 的各组非空、内部每对相邻元素依 r 相连，且组的末元素不连到下一组的首元素；如此分好、连接成某序列的组列，是该序列唯一的分组。

laws.en: For words that are nonempty, each written as a first element followed by the rest, grouping by r recovers the words of every encoded sequence of words exactly where each word is linked by r inside and no word's last element is linked to any word's first: both are conditions on adjacent pairs.
laws.zh: 词非空、各写成首元素加其余部分时，按 r 分组恢复每个由词编码的序列中的词，恰当每个词内部依 r 相连且没有词的末元素连到任何词的首元素：两者都是相邻对上的条件。

laws.en: For elements compared decidedly, a record of observed slots, where a gap breaks adjacency, bonds x to y where more than half the transitions observed from x go to y; such a majority bond links each element to at most one successor.
laws.zh: 元素可判定地比较时，观察槽的记录（空槽打断相邻）把 x 联结到 y，是指从 x 观察到的转移有过半到 y；这样的多数联结使每个元素至多连到一个后继。

laws.en: For nonempty words over decidedly compared elements and fixed elements x and y ≠ z (two words continuing x differently inside), where every record whose majority bonds link each word inside bonds x both to y and to z, no record's majority bonds group every encoded sequence into its words.
laws.zh: 对可判定比较的元素上的非空词，以及固定的元素 x 与 y ≠ z（两个词在内部以不同方式接续 x）：凡多数联结使每个词内部相连的记录都把 x 既联结到 y 又联结到 z 时，没有记录的多数联结能把每个编码序列分成其词。

laws.en: For any process in which every nonempty word is a course from s back to s, every sequence of words written out is such a course, and grouping by r recovers the words of every course of words exactly where each word is linked inside and no word's last move is linked to any word's first; the moves of any course are grouped as L exactly where L is grouped and joins to them.
laws.zh: 对任一过程，每个非空词都是从 s 回到 s 的历程时，每个写出的词序列也是这样的历程；按 r 分组恢复每个由词组成之历程的词，恰当每个词内部相连且没有词的末一步连到任何词的首一步；任一历程诸步分组为 L，恰当 L 已分好且连接成这些步。

laws.en: Where, in a process, every nonempty word over decidedly compared moves is a course from s back to s, and for fixed moves x and y ≠ z every record whose majority bonds link each word inside bonds x both to y and to z, then for the record of the first n moves of any run of any process, grouping by its majority bonds does not recover the words of all courses of words from s back to s.
laws.zh: 过程中，可判定比较的步上的每个非空词都是从 s 回到 s 的历程，且对固定的步 x 与 y ≠ z，凡多数联结使每个词内部相连的记录都把 x 既联结到 y 又联结到 z 时：对任一过程任一运行前 n 步的记录，按其多数联结分组不能恢复所有从 s 回到 s 的词历程的词。

laws.en: With four sounds a, b, c, d and the two words a b and c d, grouping by any relation r recovers the words of every sequence of the two words exactly where r links a to b and c to d and links b to neither a nor c and d to neither a nor c.
laws.zh: 取四个声音 a、b、c、d 与两个词 a b、c d：按任一关系 r 分组恢复两词组成的每个序列的词，恰当 r 把 a 连到 b、c 连到 d，而 b 不连到 a 或 c，d 也不连到 a 或 c。

laws.en: With four sounds a, b, c, d and the words a b and c d, the ideal relation, linking exactly a to b and c to d, recovers every sequence of the two words; after a supplied formation of 28 units receives the context a b a b c d c d a b, the majority bonds of its record are the ideal relation, so every such sequence is grouped into its words.
laws.zh: 取四个声音与词 a b、c d：理想关系恰把 a 连到 b、c 连到 d，恢复两词组成的每个序列；给定的 28 单位构成接收语境 a b a b c d c d a b 之后，其记录的多数联结就是理想关系，所以每个这样的序列都被分成其词。

laws.en: Identical frequencies can hide different transitions: the course a a a b b b c c d d holds every sound as often as the context a b a b c d c d a b, yet its record does not bond a to b where the context's does, and a supplied formation of 28 units that receives it does not parse the utterance c d a b c d.
laws.zh: 相同频率可以掩盖不同的转移：历程 a a a b b b c c d d 中每个声音的次数与语境 a b a b c d c d a b 相同，但其记录不把 a 联结到 b，而语境的记录会；接收它的给定 28 单位构成不能解析话语 c d a b c d。

laws.en: Repetition can join across the intended words: the majority bonds of the record a b a b group that sequence as one group, which is not read. A supplied formation of 21 units that receives a b a b and, failing to parse the utterance c d a b c d, receives further slots stops at the record a b a b c d c, which parses the utterance into its intended meaning with no response and does not parse c d c d.
laws.zh: 重复可以跨过预定的词界相连：记录 a b a b 的多数联结把该序列分为一组，无法读取。给定的 21 单位构成接收 a b a b、解析话语 c d a b c d 失败后再接收，记录停在 a b a b c d c：它把话语解析为预定意义却无回应，且不能解析 c d c d。

laws.en: In the periphery (propext, Quot.sound), for the sounds a, b, c, d and words a b, c d: the earlier peripheral bond is the core's majority bond, so each record bonds a sound to at most one successor; a record bonding a to b and c to d and neither b nor d to a or c groups every encoded sequence into its words; after the context a b a b c d c d a b the fixed decoder parses each encoded sequence as its atoms assembled.
laws.zh: 外围（propext、Quot.sound），取声音 a、b、c、d 与词 a b、c d：原外围联结就是核心的多数联结，故每个记录把每个声音至多联结到一个后继；把 a 联到 b、c 联到 d 而 b、d 都不联到 a 或 c 的记录，把每个编码序列分成其词；语境 a b a b c d c d a b 之后，固定解码器把每个编码序列解析为其原子的组装。

hypotheses.zh: 一般律对字母表与相邻关系不加条件；实例使用四个基本事件、二词编码及 idealBond。
hypotheses.en: The general law places no condition on the alphabet or relation; the instance uses four elementary events, the two-word encoding and idealBond.

hypotheses.zh: 实际取得见证使用既定接触序列、严格多数判准与足够记录支持。
hypotheses.en: The acquisition witness uses the stated encounter sequence, strict-majority criterion and adequate recording support.

The relation is Boolean-valued; the majority bond compares elements decidedly; words are nonempty, each written as its first element followed by the rest; sequences, records and courses are finite lists.
hypotheses.zh: 关系取布尔值；多数联结可判定地比较元素；词非空，各写成首元素加其余部分；序列、记录与历程都是有限列表。

hypotheses.en: The sounds, the slots, the majority threshold, the decoder, the encounters and the prepared formation of the core instance are supplied.
hypotheses.zh: 核心实例中的声音、槽、多数阈值、解码器、接触与预备的构成都是给定的。

does_not_show.en: The grouping rule, joining from the right by adjacency, is fixed; how a formation comes to group this way is not shown.
does_not_show.zh: 分组规则（由右向左依相邻并入）是固定的；构成如何形成这样的分组未表明。

does_not_show.en: Recovery at every length does not make reading or responding executable with the stock at hand.
does_not_show.zh: 在任意长度上的恢复不使读取或回应能以现有存量执行。

does_not_show.en: Natural language, sound categories and complete cognition do not follow from the grouping law.
does_not_show.zh: 自然语言、声音类别与完整认知都不由分组律得出。

detail.zh: 重复可合并预定词界；部分经历只支持一个表达而误分另一表达。
detail.en: Repetition can merge intended boundaries; partial experience can parse one expression while misgrouping another.

detail.zh: 严格多数学得的关系是函数式的：两个词若在内部以不同元素接续同一元素，任何转移记录都不能把每个编码序列都分成其词。
detail.en: A relation learned by strict majority is functional: where two words continue one element differently inside, no record of transitions groups every encoded sequence into its words.

next_delta.en: Form the grouping rule and its majority threshold within a formation's own history of encounters instead of supplying them.
next_delta.zh: 在构成自身的接触史中形成分组规则及其多数阈值，而不是给定它们。

correspondence.zh: 该关系是日志中已观察转移的分节判准；声音分类与语言对应没有由此推导。
correspondence.en: The relation is a grouping criterion derived from observed transitions in a log; sound categories and linguistic correspondence are not derived.
